nodes.text: Wait! Wait. No stabbing. Grib is unbanded — see? No war-paint, no band. Just Grib.
The camps would take Grib back if Grib brought them your boots. Grib does not want your boots. Grib wants... a town. Maybe a friend?

choices.text: Bramblewick can be your home too, Grib.

nodes.text: Home! Grib will remember this. Grib remembers everything — every kindness, every crumb. You will see!
Yes... watching. Everyone watches Grib. But Grib will show you. Grib is patient like stone.
